title: Action on a Reduction Frame
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean word; let $q,q'$ be optional states in the 35-state control set; let $i,i',n,n'\in\mathbb{N}$; let $B,B'$ be tape contents from integer offsets to optional Boolean symbols; let $a,b,a',b'\in\mathbb{Z}$; and let $o,o'$ be Boolean output words. Suppose $i,i'\le |x|$, and choose an input move $m$, writes $w_0,w_1$ (each either no write or a symbol-or-blank write), head moves $d_0,d_1$, and optional output bit $e$. Assume the clamped input move takes the frame at position $i$ to position $i'$; applying the first prescribed write to the unary counter tape of length $n$ gives the unary counter tape of length $n'$; applying the second prescribed write to $B$ gives $B'$; the head offsets satisfy $a+d_0=a'$ and $b+d_1=b'$; and appending the optional bit $e$ to $o$ gives $o'$. Then applying the two-tape reduction action with these components and target state $q'$ to the canonical reduction frame with data $(x,q,i,n,B,a,b,o)$ yields the canonical reduction frame with data $(x,q',i',n',B',a',b',o')$.
hypotheses_covered: $q,q'$ are optional states in the 35-state control set
$w_0,w_1$ are optional writes of optional Boolean symbols
the clamped input move takes position $i$ to position $i'$
the first tape update takes the counter of length $n$ to the counter of length $n'$
the second tape update takes $B$ to $B'$
replaced:
Applying a two-tape reduction action to a canonical reduction frame yields the
canonical frame whose input position, counter tape, buffer tape, both head
offsets, and appended output are exactly as prescribed by the action's components;
this frame-level calculus is shared by the maximum pass and the streaming
serializer.
